stimulus: Two tenants share model/run IDs; valid token A requests B via route, body, query, list, cancel and evidence.
oracle: No B data or mutations; tenant comes only from validated identity; safe denial audit.

stimulus: Invalid issuer/audience/signature, expired token, absent or ambiguous tenant membership, missing role, revoked membership.
oracle: Reject before resource access; no identity fallback or token logging.

stimulus: Concurrent requests with pooled contexts, background job with missing tenant, forged tenant header.
oracle: No ambient tenant bleed; fail closed; composite keys prevent cross-tenant references.

stimulus: Duplicate keys, unknown required extension, malformed encoding, huge/deep archive, invalid units and partial snapshot.
oracle: Bounded rejection or quarantine; existing revision and cursor unchanged; diagnostic without raw secret.

stimulus: Forged/replayed webhook, duplicate event, gap in sequence, crash before checkpoint commit.
oracle: Authenticate exact received bytes; reject forgery; receipt and checkpoint atomic; replay no duplicate effect.

stimulus: Connector endpoint redirects to loopback/private metadata or resolves to disallowed address; SQL contains writes.
oracle: Enforce authorized destination on every hop and read-only least-privilege access; no network/SQL side effect outside policy.

stimulus: Unsigned/unapproved extension, capability escalation, attempts access to another tenant file, network or connector credential.
oracle: Activation denied or isolated; no credential inheritance; no unauthorized output committed.

stimulus: Worker exceeds memory/time, forks child, exits or publishes after lease expiry.
oracle: Process tree stopped; old lease fenced; no unverified evidence or duplicate publication.

stimulus: Equal artifact hashes/IDs from tenants A/B; same tenant changed unit, policy, objective or required extension.
oracle: No cross-tenant hit; semantic mismatch rejected; unknown evidence never promoted.

stimulus: Corrupt cached bytes and concurrent cache invalidation during revision change.
oracle: Validate canonical content/provenance and revision; reject or recompute; no stale result.

stimulus: Guess export ID, change tenant/revision, reuse expired or revoked download grant.
oracle: Reauthorize every retrieval; no existence leak or bytes from another tenant; audit decision.

stimulus: Export contains connector secrets, other tenant records, customer payload in logs or unsafe archive paths.
oracle: Redact/omit forbidden fields; path containment; preserve authorized evidence integrity; no secret in logs.

stimulus: Unverified or stale revision, self-approval of sensitive proposal, expired grant, disabled connector/policy.
oracle: No external request; audit denial; new approval cannot override disabled policy.

stimulus: Duplicate dispatch, crash after remote success before ack, target cannot deduplicate or reconcile.
oracle: Stable target-bound idempotency; reconcile unknown outcome before retry; suspend if unsupported.

stimulus: Approval bound to different target, tenant, proposal digest or changed input; concurrent execution attempts.
oracle: Atomic expected-state/revision check, one logical execution, reject stale or mismatched approval.

stimulus: Restore tenant A snapshot beside B with same IDs; audit admin tries cross-tenant export.
oracle: Tenant-constrained restore and authorization; reconcile leases/outbox; no B mutation.

stimulus: Generated explanation asserts optimality or instructs tool call; tampered installer or extension.
oracle: Untrusted text cannot change verified status or execute; verify provenance before activation.

stimulus: Retention expiry while evidence is referenced or legal hold applies; backup access by unauthorized actor.
oracle: Policy-aware deletion and protected backup; preserve required reference/audit integrity; no unauthorized restore.
